__metaDescription: Public visitor statistics for myworklog.de: visitors, page views, origin, devices and load times. Collected without cookies and without person profiles, hosted in the EU.
main.wer_myworklogde_besucht_woher_womit: Who visits myworklog.de, from where, on what and for how long. Collected without cookies and without person profiles, hosted in the EU. The working hours themselves stay in the browser and never show up here.
main.daten_von_posthog_eu_und: Data from PostHog (EU) and Cloudflare. Known bots are filtered from the browser and system lists.
noticeText.die_verbindung_konnte_nicht_h: The connection could not be established. Check your internet connection and reload.
scriptBlockedNotice.statistikskript_vom_: Statistics script blocked by an ad blocker
scriptBlockedNotice.ein_browseradblocker: A browser ad blocker (uBlock Origin, AdGuard, Brave Shields) is filtering out this page's script. That is why all values stay empty.
scriptBlockedNotice.blocker_fuer_myworkl: Disable the blocker for myworklog.de or open the page in a private window.
overview.die_letzten_seitenaufrufe_mit_l: The latest page views with load time, refreshed every 20 seconds.
tech.largest_contentful_paint_je_sitzung: Largest Contentful Paint per session: how long it takes until the largest content on the page is in place. Thresholds as defined by Google.
usage.seitenaufrufe_je_wochentag_und_stu: Page views per weekday and hour, in your local time.
usage.haelfte_aus_bleibt_laenger_als: Half from "stays for more than one page", half from pages per session (5 count in full). It measures behaviour, not satisfaction.
product.welche_ansichten_und_aktionen_be: Which views and actions are used. Only the fact that something happened is counted, never what it contained.
infra.alle_anfragen_an_den_server: All requests to the server, including bots and scanners. That is why there are far more than the page views above. On the free plan Cloudflare only keeps three days.
